given: a SKU detail view for a stock position that has a batch_number and a serial_number
when: the operator opens the SKU detail view
then: batch and serial are presented as two separate, individually labeled fields in place of the single combined inventory_code that was previously displayed there

independence.rationale: AC1 asserts the split-field rendering on the stock table (the list surface); AC2 asserts it on the SKU detail view (a separate surface with its own layout) — the detail view could still render the old combined code while the table is fixed, and vice versa, so each surface is independently breakable

architectural_notes: Client-to-server contract on a second surface: the SKU detail page consumes the JSON boundary's split batch_number/serial_number and renders them as separate labeled fields in place of the combined inventory_code. E2E because the observable outcome is the SPA rendering fields derived from a real server response on the detail view — a distinct page/layout from AC1's table, independently breakable — and only a live-API Playwright test confirms the detail view binds the real envelope. No new persistence; reuses the inherited app/routes (react) boundary + service/repository layering.
